summary_markdown: The discussion centered on reviewing a request for comparing campaign performance data. [p1] noted that while some campaigns remained consistent, most showed significant and varied differences across different environments (staging vs. production). [me] confirmed the query structure was generally correct but suggested changing `agg_4` to `agg_5`. The core issue discussed is understanding where discrepancies in data are expected versus where they should not be, particularly when changes are made to the underlying data or facility settings.
decisions: The need for a follow-up meeting was identified to clarify goals and understand the desired outcome regarding the campaign data comparison.
action_items: [p1] will schedule a follow-up discussion with all participants.
